race.comment: Open race. Looking for the one with upside and BARRACKS (9) fits that bill nicely. He'd shown ability as a 2yo then resumed at Rosehill and won well beating the short priced favourite Affari who bolted in on Wednesday. No doubt this is a lot tougher but he gets a lovely run and should strip fitter. DOUBT TIME (6) and OVER EXCITED (12) come through clearly the best form behind The Next Episode in the G2 Danehill at Flemington. DOUBT TIME was first up and beat OVER EXCITED home, albeit the filly was much shorter and boasts a good 2nd to Satono Glow prior. Both right in this. THREADS (3) led all the way to make it two wins on the trot last start when he won over 1100m at this track. A bombproof sort of colt who will give a sight again.
